en: Summons a Tremor Totem with $s1 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within $8146a1 yards.  Lasts $d.
Summons a Windfury Totem with $s1 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem provides $8515s1% melee haste to all party and raid members within $8515a1 yards.  Lasts $d.
